Nazlı Bulut, yeni ekran tasarımını beğendiğini belirtti. Yönetici, izinli olduğu günlerde yetkisini yazılı olarak bir vekile devreder. Hukuk Müşavirliği personeli için yeni bir bilgilendirme toplantısı planlanıyor. Sistem kesintisi durumunda işlemler elle tutulan çizelgeye yazılır ve sonra sisteme aktarılır. Süreçle ilgili eğitimler yılda en az bir kez tekrarlanır. Hukuk Müşavirliği, süreçle ilgili soruları 2 iş günü içinde yanıtlamakla yükümlüdür. Kayıt ekranında yazı tipi büyütme seçeneği kullanıldı. Yazı İşleri ile Hukuk Müşavirliği arasındaki devirler devir formu ile belgelenir. Haber metni aslı istenmeden önce taranmış kopyası kabul edilebilir. Düzeltme talebi kapatılmadan önce tüm ekler okunabilirlik açısından kontrol edilir. Hava yağmurlu olduğu için yüz yüze görüşme çevrim içi yapıldı. Ekip lideri yıllık izinden yeni döndü. Kayıt sahibine otomatik bir alındı bildirimi gönderildi. Kayıt üzerinde yapılan her değişiklik, değişikliği yapan kullanıcının adıyla günlüğe yazılır. Ofisteki toplantı odası bakım nedeniyle bu hafta kullanılamıyor. Şule Tekin, bir meslektaşının da benzer bir soru sorabileceğini söyledi. Görüşme notları sisteme kısa süre içinde girildi. Kayıt, mesai saatleri içinde oluşturuldu.

İyi çalışmalar.

Subject: Subsidy application

Hello Amelia,

Instruction:
1. If the title or lease is missing, the record is put on hold and the requester is informed.
2. Abbreviations are not used in records; explanations are written as full sentences.
3. Provincial Directorate owns this procedure and approves any changes to it.
4. Training on this process is repeated at least once a year.
5. Internal audit samples records from this process once a year.
6. The requester reviews the list of open subsidy applications every week and adds notes where needed.
7. The current version of the forms used in this process is published on the intranet.
8. If several records exist for the same matter, the oldest one is used as the master record.
9. Every change to the record is logged with the name of the user who made it.
10. All correspondence about the subsidy application is copied to the District Agriculture Office shared mailbox.
11. Handovers between Provincial Directorate and Inspection Unit are documented with a handover form.
12. Provincial Directorate must answer process questions within 2 business days.
13. Requests received by phone are converted into a written record on the same day.
14. Personal data is viewed and shared only to the extent the task requires.
15. The total extension that can be granted for a subsidy application is 25 business days; a new request plus earlier extensions may not exceed it. 1 week counts as 5 business days.
16. During a system outage, actions are logged on a manual sheet and entered later.
17. The invoice is scanned and archived by Provincial Directorate within 10 business days.
18. When on leave, the automated system delegates authority to a deputy in writing.
19. Before any subsidy application is closed, all attachments are checked for legibility.

states.a63c292277ab:
NORRLAND MICROSYSTEMS REPORTS SECOND-QUARTER 2026 FINANCIAL RESULTS; ANNOUNCES COST-REDUCTION PLAN AND DIVIDEND SUSPENSION

SAN JOSE, Calif., July 30, 2026 — Norrland Microsystems Inc. today reported second-quarter 2026 revenue of $11.9 billion, down 2% year over year. GAAP earnings per share attributable to Norrland was $(0.31); non-GAAP EPS was $0.03.

"Our Q2 financial performance was disappointing, even as we hit key product and process milestones," said CEO Lucian Abernethy-Osei. "Second-half trends are more challenging than we previously expected, and we are taking decisive action to improve margins and strengthen our balance sheet."

BUSINESS OUTLOOK
Norrland's guidance for the third quarter of 2026 includes both GAAP and non-GAAP estimates:
- Revenue: $11.5 billion to $12.5 billion
- Gross margin: 34.5% GAAP; 37.0% non-GAAP
- Earnings (loss) per share attributable to Norrland: $(0.22) GAAP; $(0.02) non-GAAP
Actual results may differ materially from this outlook.

COST REDUCTIONS
The company is implementing a plan to reduce spending, including a headcount reduction of more than 15%, the majority of which is expected to be completed by the end of 2026. Norrland expects to record restructuring charges in connection with the plan; further details will be provided with third-quarter results. Gross capital expenditures for 2026 are now expected to be $24 billion to $26 billion, roughly 20% below the previous expectation.

DIVIDEND
The Board of Directors has suspended the company's quarterly dividend beginning with the fourth quarter of 2026. The third-quarter dividend of $0.125 per share, declared on June 18, 2026, will be paid on September 1, 2026, to shareholders of record as of August 7, 2026. Norrland remains committed to a competitive dividend over the long term as cash flows improve.

FORWARD-LOOKING STATEMENTS
This release contains forward-looking statements, including statements about the company's outlook, cost-reduction plan, capital spending and dividend. Such statements involve risks and uncertainties, including changes in demand for the company's products, competitive pressure, manufacturing yields and ramp timing, the timing and cost of the restructuring, and the factors described in the company's most recent Form 10-K and Form 10-Q.
